Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Investigated**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1, which was unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was v2.3.0.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The rollback was approved and rolled out successfully.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident INC-0001 for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer was paged.
